body.message:
Yes, we do offer 12-month stays at Upside Living. The studio is AED 5,500/month, all-inclusive, covering water, electricity, and internet.

The one thing to know is that rates are confirmed in 3-month blocks. We can lock in the current rate for the first 3 months, then confirm each new period ahead of time based on the season. A fixed price across all 12 months upfront isn't something we can guarantee.

When are you looking to move in?
